API ReferenceZIdentity APIUsersUsers Ops Remove
Users Ops Remove
DELETE
https://api.zsapi.net/ziam/admin/api/v1/users/:id

Deletes an existing user from the system by the provided user ID.

Request
​
PATH PARAMETERS
id
string
REQUIRED

Unique identifier of the user to be deleted.

Responses
​
204
401

The user was successfully deleted.

No content is returned in the response, but headers may be useful for validation purposes.
